title: Comparison of Algorithm for Estimating Epifascial Fibrosis in CT Images
author: Kyo-In Koo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7qbhmsn

steps.title: Load CT Image
steps.instruction: Load the original CT image file into MATLAB.

steps.title: Select Limb Region
steps.instruction: Select the reticulated limb region from the loaded image.

steps.title: Filter Pixels by Hounsfield Units
steps.instruction: Isolate skin, muscle, and bone by eliminating pixels within the range of -50 HU to 26 HU.

substeps.instruction: Remove any remaining noise using a simple opening filter or manually.

steps.title: Discriminate Connected Regions
steps.instruction: Use the MATLAB regionprops function to discriminate connected regions.

substeps.instruction: Eliminate all regions containing fewer than 20 pixels.

steps.title: Extract and Dilate Outmost Skin
steps.instruction: Convert the recognized image into a binary image and extract the outmost skin using the MATLAB bwboundaries function.

substeps.instruction: Dilate the extracted skin to create a thick boundary.

steps.title: Isolate Internal Connected Regions
steps.instruction: Eliminate the outmost skin from the connected regions using the thick outmost boundary.

steps.title: Reconstruct Inside Region
steps.instruction: Reconstruct the inside regions into a single connected region using the MATLAB imclose function.

steps.title: Merge Boundary and Inside Region
steps.instruction: Combine the thick outmost boundary and the reconstructed inside region using logical operations.

steps.title: Reverse Pixel Conversion
steps.instruction: Reversely convert the black and white pixels of the merged regions.

steps.title: Extract Reticulated Patterns
steps.instruction: Use the reversely converted region and logical operations to extract reticulated patterns as a donut-like shape from the reticulated limb region.

steps.title: Identify Epifascial Fibrosis
steps.instruction: Identify the epifascial lymph-proliferative fibrosis by selecting the nonblack pixels of the extracted reticulated patterns.
